title: Automated Inventory Reconciliation for Boutique Retailers
business: Small boutique retailers managing inventory across physical storefronts and digital storefronts.
problem: Manual inventory reconciliation between physical stock and digital storefronts leads to overselling items, resulting in customer dissatisfaction and operational overhead.
solution: By developing a custom ChatGPT plugin that interfaces with an inventory management API, retailers can enable the AI to query real-time stock levels and trigger automated adjustments directly through natural language commands in the chat interface.
steps: Define an OpenAPI specification that maps natural language intents to specific inventory API endpoints.
Implement a secure authentication layer using OAuth to ensure the AI only accesses authorized store data.
Deploy a manifest file that describes the plugin capabilities and endpoints to the ChatGPT plugin registry.
Configure the plugin to handle JSON-formatted requests from the model to update stock counts or fetch availability.
outcome: Retailers achieve synchronized inventory states across channels without manual data entry, reducing overselling incidents.
limitation: The plugin relies on the accuracy of the underlying inventory API; if the API returns stale data, the AI will provide incorrect stock information, which can be verified by checking the API response logs against physical stock counts.
